title: applied-ml-experiment-daily-scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - Applied ML experiment notes
Owner: Ethan Park
Quick context:
- Trying to quantify perf/quality tradeoffs for 13B family (open-13b-qlora / redwood-v1-13b-quant) under different quant profiles 
- Goal: recommend a default quant/profile for Hosted API low-latency tier that keeps >98% instruction-following accuracy while reducing token cost >= 2x vs FP16
- Running on H100-80 (dedicated) and A100-80 (local dev) for comparison

Today (2026-03-04) run log:
- Experiment ids: run_20260304_a (H100, 4-bit GPTQ, act-order), run_20260304_b (A100, 4-bit RTN), run_20260304_c (H100, 8-bit PTQ baseline)
- Configs: temp=0.2, top_p=0.9, max_tokens=256, batch_size=8 (inference), kv-cache warm-up enabled for prefetched prompts
- Prompt sets used: summarization-50 (short news), instruction-follow-100 (mix of multi-turn), code-smoke-20 (python snippets), hallucination-check-30 (knowledge probes)

Key metrics (preliminary):
- run_20260304_a (H100, 4-bit GPTQ): p50 latency (256 tokens): 120ms, p95: 340ms, throughput (tokens/s): 11.6, cost est: ~0.45x FP16, instr-follow acc (binary pass on eval set): 96.5%
- run_20260304_b (A100, 4-bit RTN): p50 latency: 155ms, p95: 420ms, throughput: 9.2, cost est: ~0.42x FP16, instr-follow acc: 94.8%
- run_20260304_c (H100, 8-bit PTQ): p50: 130ms, p95: 360ms, throughput: 10.8, cost est: ~0.72x FP16, instr-follow acc: 97.6%
- Notes: GPTQ-4 reduces cost the most but drops instruction-following by ~2-3 points vs 8-bit PTQ. Some failure modes in code-smoke (missing closing parens) more common in RTN profile on A100.

Qualitative notes / examples:
- Failing prompt example (from instruction-follow-100): "Translate and explain: def f(x): return x**2" -> GPTQ-4 sometimes truncates the explanation, likely due to tokenization edge-case in conditional generation.
- Hallucination probes: 4-bit runs show slightly higher tendency to invent dates for obscure facts; verify with more samples before concluding.

Immediate next steps (TODO):
- [ ] Run extended instr-follow set (500 items) on top-2 promising configs (run_a vs run_c) to reduce variance (E2E run on H100 dedicated pool) - estimate 2 hours
- [ ] Collect full confusion matrix for code-smoke (classify failures by syntax vs logic) - Priya to help label 60 failing cases
- [ ] Test cached-prefix behavior: run long-convo warm-up (cold-cache vs warm-cache) to measure delta in p95 for each quant profile
- [ ] Re-run GPTQ with alternate act-order seed (seed=42 -> seed=2026) to check stability across quantization RNGs
- [ ] Create PR with recommended default profile draft for product (include caveats) - target Thursday

Notes to self (fragmented/things to remember):
- Keep batch_size=8 for p95-focused tests; use 16/32 only for throughput stress tests
- Use redwood-inference/bench/runner:v2 for H100 runs (has updated kernel selection flags)
- Check GitHub PR #482 for the new kernel flag (--prefer-fused-attn) that might reduce p95 for 4-bit runs on H100

Meta/links (refs):
- Quick eval harness command (local): 
  python eval/harness.py --model open-13b-qlora --quant gptq4-act --device cuda:0 --batch 8 --prompts data/instr-follow-100.json --out results/run_20260304_a.json
- Confluence notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/AM/quant-eval-notes (see section "H100 vs A100, 4-bit GPTQ anomalies")
- Jira ticket for production rollout: APL-719 (contains acceptance criteria + perf SLOs)

Longer-term questions / hypotheses to test:
- Does 4-bit GPTQ systematically trade instruction-following accuracy for factuality, or is it dataset-dependent? Need cross-dataset test (summ, instruct, code, knowledge)
- Can runtime kernel selection (prefer-fused-attn / fp32-accum) recover some of the accuracy loss by reducing numerical error? Small experiments show a +/-1% effect but not consistent

Random todo brain-dump (low priority):
- Try qlora-finetune with 2e-5 lr on a small subset of instr-follow to see if fine-tuning narrow errors helps 4-bit profile
- Add a small unit test in bench/runner that asserts no degenerate completions (e.g., repeat token >80% for 50 tokens)

If blocked:
- Marcus to ping infra for extra H100 slots (queue is long today)
- If kernel flag causes instability, revert to runner:v1 for QA runs

End of scratchpad for 2026-03-04.

-- Ethan
